CURSEMARK_SIGNET.title: Woodgrain Signet
CURSEMARK_SIGNET.description: At the start of combat, add 1 [gold]Approach[/gold] and 1 [gold]Retreat[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
CURSEMARK_SIGNET.flavor: The grain circles the ring like a hunter measuring the space between quarry and bow.
RUNEMARK_SIGNET.title: Cursemark Signet
RUNEMARK_SIGNET.description: At the start of combat, add 1 upgraded [gold]Approach[/gold] and 1 upgraded [gold]Retreat[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
RUNEMARK_SIGNET.flavor: Ancient runes awaken along the grain, inscribing every advance and retreat.
SINGLE_WING_GREATSHIELD.title: Single-Wing Greatshield
SINGLE_WING_GREATSHIELD.description: At the start of combat, gain 5 [gold]Fortify[/gold].
SINGLE_WING_GREATSHIELD.flavor: A massive shield, broken in half. Even its remnant is formidable.
TWIN_WING_GREATSHIELD.title: Twin-Wing Greatshield
TWIN_WING_GREATSHIELD.description: At the start of combat, gain {Block} [gold]Block[/gold] and {Fortify} [gold]Fortify[/gold].
TWIN_WING_GREATSHIELD.flavor: With both wings restored, an ancient oath of protection awakens anew.
HUNTERS_DARK_NIGHT.title: Hunter's Dark Night
HUNTERS_DARK_NIGHT.description: At the start of combat, gain {GuardCounterPower} [gold]Guard Counter[/gold].
HUNTERS_DARK_NIGHT.flavor: The prey's darkest night is when the hunter sees most clearly.
FLYING_FEATHER_HELM.title: Flying-Feather Helm
FLYING_FEATHER_HELM.description: Whenever you play {Cards} cards with Defend or Defense in their names, draw 1 card.
FLYING_FEATHER_HELM.flavor: Its plume rises whenever its wearer's guard becomes absolute.
STONE_PILLAR.title: Stone Pillar
STONE_PILLAR.description: The first time you apply [gold]Weak[/gold] each turn, draw 1 card.
STONE_PILLAR.flavor: The wind may pass it. An enemy rarely can.
WITCH_BROOCH.title: Witch's Brooch
WITCH_BROOCH.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Concealed Edge[/gold] card, gain {GuardCounterPower} [gold]Guard Counter[/gold].
WITCH_BROOCH.flavor: Silence is not retreat. It is an edge hidden in the next breath.
GREEN_TALISMAN.title: Green Talisman
GREEN_TALISMAN.flavor: The jade remembers every perfect defense.
GREATSHIELD_TALISMAN.title: Greatshield Talisman
GREATSHIELD_TALISMAN.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Fortify[/gold], gain that much [gold]Block[/gold].
GREATSHIELD_TALISMAN.flavor: A tiny shield whose shadow can cover the whole body.
TACTICAL_COMPENDIUM.title: Tactical Compendium
TACTICAL_COMPENDIUM.description: At the start of combat, add 1 upgraded [gold]Shield Poke[/gold] to your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
TACTICAL_COMPENDIUM.flavor: Every page depicts the same motion, yet no two pages are alike.
CRACKED_SEALING_WAX.title: Cracked Sealing Wax
CRACKED_SEALING_WAX.description: At the start of combat, apply {MarkPower} [gold]Mark[/gold] to ALL enemies.
CRACKED_SEALING_WAX.flavor: The seal has split, but every name within remains legible.
WISDOMS_DARK_NIGHT.title: Wisdom's Dark Night
WISDOMS_DARK_NIGHT.description: At the start of combat, apply {HiddenPoisonPower} [gold]Hidden Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
WISDOMS_DARK_NIGHT.flavor: The quietest poison waits in the clearest night.
PROTECTIVE_SCALE_ARMOR.title: Protective Scale Armor
PROTECTIVE_SCALE_ARMOR.flavor: Each scale closes toward the place the arrow came from.
FAR_ARROW_TALISMAN.title: Far Arrow Talisman
FAR_ARROW_TALISMAN.flavor: The closer the quarry, the quieter the fletching trembles.
HARD_ARROW_TALISMAN.title: Hard Arrow Talisman
HARD_ARROW_TALISMAN.description: The first time [gold]Long Shot[/gold] triggers each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
HARD_ARROW_TALISMAN.flavor: Before the string sings, the heavy arrowhead has chosen its landing.
SACRED_RHYTHM_BLADE.title: Sacred Rhythm Blade
SACRED_RHYTHM_BLADE.flavor: Its arc corrects the error between arrow and quarry.
GLIDING_GARB.title: Gliding Garb
GLIDING_GARB.flavor: The cloak skims the ground without leaving dust worth following.
SMALL_MAKEUP_BRUSH.title: Small Makeup Brush
SMALL_MAKEUP_BRUSH.flavor: Its soft bristles still carry the faint fragrance of an old dressing table.
TREASURED_MAKEUP_BRUSH.title: Treasured Makeup Brush
TREASURED_MAKEUP_BRUSH.description: At the start of combat, [gold]Call[/gold], then [gold]Resonate[/gold].
TREASURED_MAKEUP_BRUSH.flavor: Time has polished its handle, but laughter still clings to the bristles.
DIRTY_PHOTO_FRAME.title: Dirty Photo Frame
DIRTY_PHOTO_FRAME.description: At the start of combat, choose 1 card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to discard.
DIRTY_PHOTO_FRAME.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose 1 card from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to discard.
DIRTY_PHOTO_FRAME.flavor: Dust hides the faces, but not the hand reaching beyond the frame.
MINIATURE_MAKEUP_TOOLS.title: Miniature Makeup Tools
MINIATURE_MAKEUP_TOOLS.flavor: Tiny implements that help each returning soul stand tall again.
DEEP_SEA_NIGHT.title: Deep Sea Night
DEEP_SEA_NIGHT.description: After you [gold]Resonate[/gold], your [gold]Family[/gold] member gains {MaxHp} HP.
DEEP_SEA_NIGHT.flavor: Night sinks beneath the waves and shelters the faintest breath.
OLD_POCKET_PORTRAIT.title: Old Pocket Portrait
OLD_POCKET_PORTRAIT.description: After the first [gold]Resonance[/gold] each turn, draw {Cards} card.
OLD_POCKET_PORTRAIT.flavor: Its faded faces remind her that every answer has a listener.
BLUE_AMBER_AMULET.title: Blue Amber Amulet
BLUE_AMBER_AMULET.flavor: Blue light within the amber guides scattered things back to the hand.
BELIEVERS_VOW_CLOTH.title: Believer's Vow Cloth
BELIEVERS_VOW_CLOTH.description: After a card is [gold]Charged[/gold], it costs 0 until played.
BELIEVERS_VOW_CLOTH.flavor: The oath has faded, but the promise still binds every finger.
PORTABLE_SEWING_KIT.title: Portable Sewing Kit
PORTABLE_SEWING_KIT.description: Whenever you [gold]Recover[/gold], your [gold]Family[/gold] member gains {MaxHp} HP.
PORTABLE_SEWING_KIT.flavor: Each stitch mends both a torn hem and an unfinished goodbye.
SEA_GLASS.GUARDIAN.title: Guardian Glass
SEA_GLASS.IRONEYE.title: Ironeye Glass
SEA_GLASS.REVENANT.title: Revenant Glass
